reviews.note: The functional study tested tiamulin, a pleuromutilin derivative, not the parent pleuromutilin structure represented here. Its results do not establish resistance to this exact compound. Retain CARD's route-level assertion as database evidence only; no experimental allele, protein, organism or susceptibility observation is assigned.

reviews.note: Earlier studies reported no independent resistance contribution in their tested contexts, including work using the historical mcr-4.2 name later corrected to mcr-4.3. A later clinical Acinetobacter study reported contrasting functional and lipid A results. These are context-dependent, conflicting findings, not universal activity or inactivity. They do not establish resistance to purified colistin A or B separately. Retain CARD's assertion as database evidence only; no experimental protein, organism or susceptibility observation is assigned.
